scripts.build: npm run build -w nirupi-web && npm run build -w nirupi-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w nirupi-server && npm run lint -w nirupi-web
scripts.reset-data: node -e "for (const d of ['vivas', 'reports']) require('fs').rmSync('server/.data/' + d, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleared saved vivas and reports (the prepared demo project is kept).')"
